headline: A 2022 law renames a VA outpatient clinic in Canton, Michigan, after Major General Oliver W. Dillard.
what_it_does: This act gives a Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Canton, Michigan, a new official name: the Major General Oliver W. Dillard VA Clinic. It changes only the name. It does not change the clinic's services, staffing, or funding. The law was signed on December 20, 2022.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 20, 2022.
